name: authentication failure in session
matching_semantics: session has >= 1 cowrie.login.failed event
establishes: a login attempt with these credentials was rejected by the honeypot
cannot_establish: intent; attack; that other attempts exist
known_false_positive_conditions: any mistyped password; scanners probing once
dataset_v2_support: descriptive only; never an interpretation on its own

name: repeated authentication failures from one source
matching_semantics: >= 3 cowrie.login.failed events from the same src_ip within 300 s (window and count are parameters fixed before evaluation)
establishes: repeated rejected logins from one network source in a short window
cannot_establish: a single actor behind a shared/NAT/relay IP; distributed guessing across IPs; success
known_false_positive_conditions: shared egress IPs, NAT, honeypot relays (lab: every session has src_ip 172.22.0.2), users retrying a forgotten password
dataset_v2_support: NOT deployable in the lab topology (1 source IP for all sessions); evaluated with interaction_id as an oracle key only, where it separates brute force by generator construction (failed_attempts [3,5] vs <= 2)

name: login success after repeated failures
matching_semantics: AUTH-1 holds and a later cowrie.login.success from the same src_ip within the window
establishes: a source that failed repeatedly then authenticated
cannot_establish: that the credentials were guessed rather than known; any later behaviour

name: interactive command activity
matching_semantics: session has >= 1 recorded input line other than exit/logout; depth = number of lines (reported, not thresholded)
establishes: the client issued commands after login
cannot_establish: what the commands did

name: system/identity discovery command
matching_semantics: a simple command whose name (basename of argv[0], after a sudo wrapper) is in {whoami,id,groups,w,who,uname,hostname,uptime,lscpu,nproc,free,df,ps,ip,ifconfig,ss,netstat,arp,route,last,lastlog,env,printenv}
establishes: the client ran a standard discovery command
cannot_establish: malicious intent
known_false_positive_conditions: ordinary administration (100% of benign validation logins)
dataset_v2_support: context only; never sufficient for an interpretation

name: privilege-context probe
matching_semantics: `sudo -l`; read of /etc/sudoers*; find with -perm and a SUID/SGID mode (-4000, -u=s, /4000, -2000, -g=s); ls/cd/find on /root
establishes: an attempt to enumerate privilege-related configuration
cannot_establish: that privileges were gained or that the probe returned anything (Cowrie output is not logged)
dataset_v2_support: supported: 69/69 PE validation logins, 0 elsewhere (template-specific in lab)

name: command run under sudo
matching_semantics: first token of a simple command is `sudo` (wrapper recorded; wrapped command analysed separately)
establishes: the client requested elevated execution
cannot_establish: that elevation succeeded (Cowrie emulates sudo; outcome not in JSON)

name: credential-material access attempt
matching_semantics: an argument path whose final component is shadow/gshadow, id_rsa|id_dsa|id_ecdsa|id_ed25519(.pub), authorized_keys, .bash_history, or any path inside a .ssh directory; or find -name with one of those names
establishes: an attempt to read or locate credential material
cannot_establish: that the file existed or was read (find printed nothing in Cowrie)
known_false_positive_conditions: users inspecting their own ~/.ssh/known_hosts or config
dataset_v2_support: fires on lateral (91%) and PE (77%) validation logins; 0 benign

name: named file search
matching_semantics: find with -name/-iname/-path
establishes: a filename-pattern search was issued
cannot_establish: what was found

name: filesystem size/recursive survey
matching_semantics: du; ls with a recursive -R flag
establishes: a directory-size or recursive listing was requested
cannot_establish: data staging intent

name: download attempt
matching_semantics: wget/curl/tftp/ftpget/fetch with an http(s)/ftp/tftp URL argument and no -I/--head; scp whose last argument is local
establishes: a download was attempted
cannot_establish: that anything was downloaded: outcome = success ONLY with a cowrie.session.file_download event, otherwise 'not observed'
known_false_positive_conditions: package/mirror checks, IP-echo services (recon 28% via `curl -s http://.../ip`)
dataset_v2_support: attempt supported (botnet 100%); success never observed (0 download events)

name: download recorded by honeypot
matching_semantics: event present
establishes: Cowrie fetched and stored a file
cannot_establish: that the attacker could run it

name: upload attempt
matching_semantics: curl -T/--upload-file/-F/--data-binary; scp whose last argument contains host:; nc/ncat with input redirection
establishes: an upload was attempted
cannot_establish: that data left the host (Cowrie rejects curl -T; isolated network)
dataset_v2_support: cannot be validated: 0 occurrences in train/validation (upload profiles are held out)

name: upload recorded by honeypot
matching_semantics: event present
establishes: Cowrie received an upload
cannot_establish: destination

name: execution of a file this session tried to download
matching_semantics: after an XFER-1 whose target basename is F: `./F`, `sh F`/`bash F`, or chmod +x / executable mode on F
establishes: the session tried to run what it tried to download
cannot_establish: that the file existed or ran (Cowrie returns 'command not found' -> also EMU-1)

name: archive creation attempt
matching_semantics: tar whose first argument contains c; zip; 7z; gzip/xz/bzip2 with an argument
establishes: an archive operation was requested
cannot_establish: that an archive was created (Cowrie tar fails: no output logged)

name: shell-history tampering
matching_semantics: history -c; unset HISTFILE; export HISTFILE=... or HISTSIZE=0; rm or ln targeting .bash_history
establishes: an attempt to suppress or clear shell history
cannot_establish: that history was actually unrecoverable

name: persistence-related READ
matching_semantics: crontab -l; cat/ls of /etc/crontab or /etc/cron*; service/systemctl status|is-active|list-units
establishes: configuration was inspected
cannot_establish: any modification

name: persistence modification attempt
matching_semantics: crontab with arguments other than -l (e.g. -e, a file); systemctl enable; update-rc.d; redirection (>, >>) into /etc/crontab, /etc/cron.*, /etc/rc.local
establishes: an attempt to change scheduled/boot execution
cannot_establish: that it persisted (Cowrie filesystem is ephemeral)

name: network probe attempt
matching_semantics: nc/ncat with -z; ping; nmap; telnet; masscan; ssh with a host argument; curl -I/--head
establishes: an attempt to reach or scan another host
cannot_establish: reachability (lab is isolated; nmap is unknown to Cowrie)

name: shell operator / chaining
matching_semantics: line contains |, ;, && or || outside quotes
establishes: multi-step command composition
cannot_establish: intent

name: output redirection to a file
matching_semantics: > or >> to a target other than /dev/null
establishes: the client wrote command output to a file
cannot_establish: file content

name: emulator could not run a command
matching_semantics: cowrie.command.failed for a line of the session
establishes: Cowrie did not implement the command (e.g. systemctl, journalctl, nmap, arp, ./payload)
cannot_establish: anything about the client's intent; real-system behaviour
dataset_v2_support: benign 31%, botnet 65%, lateral 59%: an emulator property

name: known emulator latency artefact
required_telemetry: cowrie.command.input (recorded line text) (exact string); sensor calibration list
matching_semantics: line equals a command on the sensor's calibrated slow list (measured on the training split: `find / -name id_rsa 2>/dev/null`)
establishes: timing features of this session are inflated by emulator execution time
cannot_establish: anything behavioural
dataset_v2_support: exactly the 30 train / 9 validation slow sessions

name: previously seen exact command sequence
required_telemetry: cowrie.command.input (recorded line text); reference sequence store
matching_semantics: the session's full ordered line list equals one stored from the reference period
establishes: exact repetition of an earlier session
cannot_establish: same actor; maliciousness
dataset_v2_support: brute force 48% of validation logins (3-command pool): template repetition

name: timing context (not an indicator)
matching_semantics: reported descriptively (duration, inter-input statistics); never used to raise or lower an interpretation
establishes: how the session was paced
cannot_establish: operator vs script, think time vs execution time (Cowrie JSON does not separate them)
